Naaman’s misunderstanding is similar to the Zoramites’ misunderstanding in the Book of Mormon. They felt God could be worshipped only on a holy stand in their synagogue. Alma corrected this misunderstanding by teaching that God could be worshipped from any location (seeAlma 33:2–11).
